    <script id="berqwp-img-lazyload" async="">
      document.addEventListener(&#39;DOMContentLoaded&#39;, function () {
                    var berq_img_lazy_options = {
                        root: null, // null means the viewport
                        rootMargin: &#39;0px&#39;,
                        threshold: 0
                    };

                    var img_observer = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries, observer) {
                        entries.forEach(function (entry) {
                            if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                                let img = entry.target;
                                let imgSrc = img.getAttribute(&#39;data-berqwpsrc&#39;);
                                let imgSrcset = img.getAttribute(&#39;data-berqwp-srcset&#39;);

                                // Set the actual image source from data-berqwpsrc
                                if (imgSrc !== null) {
                                    img.src = imgSrc;
                                }

                                if (imgSrcset !== null) {
                                    img.srcset = imgSrcset;
                                }

                                if (img.getAttribute(&#39;data-srcset&#39;) !== null) {
                                    img.srcset = img.getAttribute(&#39;data-srcset&#39;);
                                }

                                // You might want to remove the data-src attribute after loading
                                img.removeAttribute(&#39;data-berqwpsrc&#39;);
                                img.removeAttribute(&#39;data-berqwp-srcset&#39;);

                                img_observer.unobserve(img);
                            }
                        });
                    }, berq_img_lazy_options);

                    function berqwp_lazyload_images() {
                        let lazyImages = document.querySelectorAll(&#39;img[data-berqwpsrc]&#39;);
                        lazy_img_int = 1000;

                        lazyImages.forEach(function (img) {
                            img_observer.observe(img);
                        });
                    }

                    function berqwp_lazyload_source() {
                        let lazyImages = document.querySelectorAll(&#39;source[data-berqwp-srcset]&#39;);
                        lazy_img_int = 1000;

                        lazyImages.forEach(function (img) {
                            img_observer.observe(img);
                        });
                    }

                    berqwp_lazyload_images();
                    setInterval(berqwp_lazyload_images, 1000);
                    setInterval(berqwp_lazyload_source, 1000);

                });

                document.addEventListener(&#39;DOMContentLoaded&#39;, function () {

                    // Set up IntersectionObserver to lazy load background images
                    let bwp_bg_observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries, observer) =&gt; {
                        entries.forEach(entry =&gt; {
                            if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                                // Get the element that entered the viewport
                                const element = entry.target;

                                // Get the background image from the data-bg attribute
                                const bgImage = element.getAttribute(&#39;data-berqwpbg&#39;);

                                // If there&#39;s a data-bg attribute, set the background image
                                if (bgImage) {
                                    element.style.backgroundImage = &#39;url(&#39;+bgImage+&#39;)&#39;;
                                    element.removeAttribute(&#39;data-berqwpbg&#39;); // Remove the data-bg attribute after loading
                                }

                                // Stop observing the element once it&#39;s loaded
                                bwp_bg_observer.unobserve(element);
                            }
                        });
                    });

                    function berqwp_lazyload_bg_images() {
                        const lazyElements = document.querySelectorAll(&#39;.lazy-berqwpbg&#39;);

                        // Observe each lazy-loaded element
                        lazyElements.forEach(element =&gt; {
                            bwp_bg_observer.observe(element);
                        });
                    }

                    berqwp_lazyload_bg_images();
                    setInterval(berqwp_lazyload_bg_images, 1000);

                });

                                    }, 5000); // 5 seconds timeout

                            // Start loading scripts from the first one
                            loadScript(0);

    <script data-berqwp="" id="berqwp-preloader" defer="">
      class berqwpPreloader {
    jobId = 0;
    pending = new Map();

    _preloadAssets(assets, asType) {
        const seen = new Set();
        const unique = assets.filter(({ url }) =&gt; {
            if (seen.has(url)) return false;
            seen.add(url);
            return true;
        });

        const id = ++this.jobId;

        return new Promise((resolve) =&gt; {
            if (unique.length === 0) {
                console.log(&#39;[berqwp] empty — resolving immediately&#39;);  // Is it bailing here?
                resolve({ status: &#39;done&#39;, failed: [] });
                return;
            }

            this.pending.set(id, resolve);

            let completed = 0;
            const failed = [];

            const onSettle = () =&gt; {
                completed++;
                if (completed === unique.length) {
                    this.pending.delete(id);
                    resolve({ status: &#39;done&#39;, failed });
                }
            };

            unique.forEach(({ url, crossOrigin }) =&gt; {
                const alreadyPreloaded = document.querySelector(`link[rel=&#34;preload&#34;][as=&#34;${asType}&#34;][href=&#34;${url}&#34;]`);
                const alreadyScript    = asType === &#39;script&#39; &amp;&amp; document.querySelector(`script[src=&#34;${url}&#34;]:not([type=&#34;text/bwp-script&#34;])`);
                const alreadyStyle     = asType === &#39;style&#39;  &amp;&amp; document.querySelector(`link[rel=&#34;stylesheet&#34;][href=&#34;${url}&#34;]`);

                if (alreadyPreloaded || alreadyScript || alreadyStyle) {
                    return onSettle();
                }

                const link = document.createElement(&#39;link&#39;);
                link.rel  = &#39;preload&#39;;
                link.as   = asType;
                link.href = url;

                if (crossOrigin) {
                    link.crossOrigin = crossOrigin;
                }

                link.onload  = () =&gt; {
                    console.log(&#39;[berqwp] preloaded:&#39;, url);  // Is onload firing?
                    onSettle();
                };
                link.onerror = () =&gt; {
                    console.warn(&#39;[berqwp] failed:&#39;, url);    // Or is it erroring?
                    failed.push(url);
                    onSettle();
                };

                document.head.appendChild(link);
            });
        });
    }

    preload(assets) {
        const normalized = assets.map(a =&gt;
            typeof a === &#39;string&#39; ? { url: a, crossOrigin: null } : a
        );
        return this._preloadAssets(normalized, &#39;script&#39;);
    }

    preloadScripts() {
        const elements = [...document.querySelectorAll(&#39;script[type=&#34;text/bwp-script&#34;]&#39;)];
        const assets = elements
            .filter(el =&gt; el.getAttribute(&#39;src&#39;))
            .map(el =&gt; ({
                url: el.getAttribute(&#39;src&#39;),
                crossOrigin: el.getAttribute(&#39;crossorigin&#39;) || null
            }));

        return this._preloadAssets(assets, &#39;script&#39;);
    }

    preloadStyles() {
        const elements = [...document.querySelectorAll(&#39;link[data-berqwp-style-href]&#39;)];
        const assets = elements
            .filter(el =&gt; el.getAttribute(&#39;data-berqwp-style-href&#39;))
            .map(el =&gt; ({
                url: el.getAttribute(&#39;data-berqwp-style-href&#39;),
                crossOrigin: el.getAttribute(&#39;crossorigin&#39;) || null
            }));

        return this._preloadAssets(assets, &#39;style&#39;);
    }

}

(function() {
    window.bwpPreloader = new berqwpPreloader();
})()
    </script>
    <script data-berqwp="" id="berqwp-worker" defer="">
      class berqwpWorker {
    worker;
    jobId = 0;
    pending = new Map();

    init() {
        const workerCode = `
            self.onmessage = async function(e) {
                const { id, urls } = e.data;

                await Promise.all(urls.map(url =&gt; {
                return fetch(url, {
                    mode: &#39;no-cors&#39;,
                    credentials: &#39;same-origin&#39;,
                    cache: &#39;force-cache&#39;
                }).catch(() =&gt; null);
                }));

                self.postMessage({ id, status: &#39;done&#39; });
            };
        `;

        const blob = new Blob([workerCode], { type: &#39;application/javascript&#39; });
        this.worker = new Worker(URL.createObjectURL(blob));

        this.worker.onmessage = (e) =&gt; {
        const { id, status } = e.data;
        const resolve = this.pending.get(id);
        if (resolve) {
            resolve({ status });
            this.pending.delete(id);
        }
        };
    }

    preload(assets) {
        if (!this.worker) {
        return Promise.resolve({ status: &#39;no-worker&#39; });
        }

        return new Promise((resolve) =&gt; {
        const id = ++this.jobId;
        this.pending.set(id, resolve);

        this.worker.postMessage({
            id,
            urls: [...new Set(assets)]
        });
        });
    }
}

(function() {

    if (!(&#39;Worker&#39; in window)) return;

    window.bwpWorker = new berqwpWorker();
    window.bwpWorker.init();

})()
    </script>

    <script id="dnkldsgn-desktop-menu-hover-guard" data-type="text/javascript" type="text/bwp-script">
      (function () {
		var desktopHover = window.matchMedia &amp;&amp; window.matchMedia( &#39;(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)&#39; ).matches;

		if ( desktopHover ) {
			document.documentElement.classList.add( &#39;dnk-menu-hover-locked&#39; );

			var unlock = function ( event ) {
				if ( ! event.movementX &amp;&amp; ! event.movementY ) {
					return;
				}

				document.documentElement.classList.remove( &#39;dnk-menu-hover-locked&#39; );
				window.removeEventListener( &#39;pointermove&#39;, unlock, true );
			};

			window.addEventListener( &#39;pointermove&#39;, unlock, true );
		}

		document.addEventListener( &#39;click&#39;, function ( event ) {
			var link = event.target.closest &amp;&amp; event.target.closest( &#39;.elementor-nav-menu--main a.elementor-sub-item[href]&#39; );

			if ( ! link || event.defaultPrevented || event.metaKey || event.ctrlKey || event.shiftKey || event.altKey || 0 !== event.button ) {
				return;
			}

			var href = link.href || link.getAttribute( &#39;href&#39; ) || &#39;&#39;;

			if ( ! href || &#39;#&#39; === href.charAt( 0 ) || link.target || link.hasAttribute( &#39;download&#39; ) ) {
				return;
			}

			document.documentElement.classList.add( &#39;dnk-menu-click-closing&#39; );
			event.preventDefault();
			window.setTimeout( function () {
				window.location.assign( href );
			}, 0 );
		}, true );

		window.addEventListener( &#39;pageshow&#39;, function () {
			document.documentElement.classList.remove( &#39;dnk-menu-click-closing&#39; );
		} );
	}() );

              <h2 class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default">
                <span class="text-marker">                Design, das überzeugt.
</span>
                Nicht nur gut aussieht.
              </h2>

            <div class="elementor-element elementor-element-327fb99 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="327fb99" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-settings="{&#34;ekit_we_effect_on&#34;:&#34;none&#34;}" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
              <p>
                Hübsch machen kann jeder.
                <br />
                Ich entwickle Auftritte, die verkaufen.
              </p>
            </div>
            <div class="elementor-element elementor-element-a31c4c1 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="a31c4c1" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-settings="{&#34;ekit_we_effect_on&#34;:&#34;none&#34;}" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
              <p>
                Es gibt viele Anbieter, die Websites bauen, Logos gestalten oder Social-Media-Posts erstellen. Die Frage ist nicht, ob jemand das technisch umsetzen kann. Die Frage ist, ob dabei ein Auftritt entsteht, der Ihr Unternehmen wirklich voranbringt.
              </p>

            <div class="elementor-element elementor-element-d584074 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="d584074" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-settings="{&#34;ekit_we_effect_on&#34;:&#34;none&#34;}" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
              <p>
                Seit 2004 arbeite ich mit Selbstständigen und mittelständischen Unternehmen, die mehr aus ihrem Auftritt herausholen wollen. Dabei setze ich auf psychologisch fundiertes Design. Gestaltung, die nicht nur gefällt, sondern unbewusst Vertrauen aufbaut, Aufmerksamkeit lenkt und zur Anfrage führt. Ich denke strategisch, gestalte zielgerichtet und sage Ihnen auch dann ehrlich meine Meinung, wenn sie unbequem ist. Das Ergebnis: Ein Auftritt, der nicht nur gut aussieht, sondern für Sie arbeitet.
              </p>

        }

        function showPopupWhenReady(attempt) {
            if (window.elementorProFrontend &amp;&amp; elementorProFrontend.modules &amp;&amp; elementorProFrontend.modules.popup) {
                elementorProFrontend.modules.popup.showPopup({ id: popupId });
                return;
            }
            if (attempt &lt; 60) {
                window.setTimeout(function () { showPopupWhenReady(attempt + 1); }, 50);
                return;
            }
            if (activeToggle) {
                activeToggle.setAttribute(&#39;aria-expanded&#39;, &#39;false&#39;);
                activeToggle = null;
            }
        }

        function closeOtherSubmenus(activeLink) {
            document.querySelectorAll(&#39;nav li.menu-item-has-children &gt; a&#39;).forEach(function (link) {
                if (link === activeLink) return;

                link.setAttribute(&#39;aria-expanded&#39;, &#39;false&#39;);
                link.classList.remove(&#39;highlighted&#39;);
                var submenu = link.parentElement.querySelector(&#39;:scope &gt; .sub-menu&#39;);
                if (submenu) {
                    submenu.style.display = &#39;none&#39;;
                    submenu.setAttribute(&#39;aria-hidden&#39;, &#39;true&#39;);
                }
            });
        }

        function keepOneSubmenuOpen(event) {
            if (!isMobile()) return;
            var link = event.target.closest(&#39;li.menu-item-has-children &gt; a&#39;);
            if (!link) return;
            window.setTimeout(function () { closeOtherSubmenus(link); }, 0);
        }

        document.addEventListener(&#39;click&#39;, keepOneSubmenuOpen, true);

        function openMenu(event) {

            event.preventDefault();

                if (Number(id) !== popupId || !activeToggle) return;

                    // Function to check if an element is partially in the viewport
                    function isInViewport(element) {
                        const rect = element.getBoundingClientRect();
                        const windowHeight = (window.innerHeight || document.documentElement.clientHeight);
                        const windowWidth = (window.innerWidth || document.documentElement.clientWidth);

                        // Check if the element is within the viewport
                        return (
                            rect.top &lt; windowHeight &amp;&amp; 
                            rect.bottom &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; 
                            rect.left &lt; windowWidth &amp;&amp; 
                            rect.right &gt; 0
                        );
                    }

                    function loadElementorAnimations() {
                        const elements = document.querySelectorAll(&#39;.elementor-element[data-settings]&#39;);
                        elements.forEach(function (element) {
                            if (isInViewport(element)) {
                                const animationSettings = element.getAttribute(&#39;data-settings&#39;);
                                const dataObj = JSON.parse(animationSettings);
                                let animationName = dataObj._animation;
                                element.classList.remove(&#39;elementor-invisible&#39;);

                                if (!animationName) {
                                    animationName = dataObj.animation;
                                }

                                // handle animations
                                if (animationName) {
                                    let animationDelay = dataObj._animation_delay;
                                    element.classList.add(&#39;animated&#39;);
                                    
                                    if (animationDelay) {
                                        setTimeout(function() {
                                            element.classList.add(animationName);
                                        }, animationDelay);
                                            
                                    } else {
                                        element.classList.add(animationName);
                                    }
    
                                    delete dataObj._animation;
                                    delete dataObj.animation;
                                }

                                    let slideshow_first_img = dataObj.background_slideshow_gallery[0].url;

                                    if (slideshow_first_img) {

                                element.setAttribute(&#39;data-settings&#39;, updatedSettings);

                                // element.removeAttribute(&#39;data-settings&#39;);
                            }
                        });

                    function loadLazyVideo(video) {
                        // Set video src from data attribute if exists
                        const videoSrc = video.getAttribute(&#39;data-berqwpsrc&#39;);
                        if (videoSrc) {
                            video.setAttribute(&#39;src&#39;, videoSrc);
                        }

                        // Find all &lt;source&gt; tags inside the video and apply their data-berqwpsrc as src
                        const sources = video.querySelectorAll(&#39;source&#39;);
                        sources.forEach(source =&gt; {
                            const sourceSrc = source.getAttribute(&#39;data-berqwpsrc&#39;);
                            if (sourceSrc) {
                                source.setAttribute(&#39;src&#39;, sourceSrc);
                            }
                        });

                        // Load the video once the sources have been set
                        video.load();
                    }

                    // Use IntersectionObserver to detect when the video is about to enter the viewport
                    let lazyVideos = [].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll(&#39;video.berqwp-lazy-video&#39;));

                    if (&#39;IntersectionObserver&#39; in window) {
                        let lazyVideoObserver = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries, observer) {
                            entries.forEach(function(entry) {
                                if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                                    let video = entry.target;
                                    loadLazyVideo(video);
                                    // Unobserve the video once it&#39;s loaded
                                    lazyVideoObserver.unobserve(video);
                                }
                            });
                        });

                        // Observe each lazy video
                        lazyVideos.forEach(function(video) {
                            lazyVideoObserver.observe(video);
                        });
                    } else {
                        // Fallback for browsers that don&#39;t support IntersectionObserver
                        lazyVideos.forEach(function(video) {
                            loadLazyVideo(video);
                        });
                    }
                });

            })()

                    return;
                }

                const fetchPromises = [];

                asset_urls.forEach(url =&gt; {
                    if (url) {
                        fetchPromises.push(
                            fetch(url, {
                                method: &#39;GET&#39;,
                                mode: &#39;cors&#39; // Ensure CORS mode is set
                            })
                            .then(response =&gt; {
                                if (!response.ok) {
                                    console.error(&#39;Failed to fetch:&#39;, response);
                                }
                                return response;
                            })
                            .catch(error =&gt; {
                                console.error(&#39;Fetch error:&#39;, error);
                                return null;
                            })
                        );
                    }
                });

                try {
                    const responses = await Promise.all(fetchPromises);

                    // Open or create a cache
                    const cache = await caches.open(&#39;berqwp-assets-cache&#39;);

                    responses.forEach(response =&gt; {
                        if (response &amp;&amp; response.ok) {
                            console.log(&#39;Preloading and caching:&#39;, response.url);

                            // Add the response to the cache
                            cache.put(response.url, response.clone());
                        }
                    });
                } catch (error) {
                    console.error(&#39;Error during fetching and caching:&#39;, error);
                }
            }

      (function() {
            const cdnBase = &#39;https://berqwp-cdn.sfo3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/&#39;;

            function collectCdnResources() {
                const resourceEntries = performance.getEntriesByType(&#39;resource&#39;);
                const cdnResources = [];

                resourceEntries.forEach(entry =&gt; {
                    if (entry.name.indexOf(cdnBase) === 0 &amp;&amp; entry.duration &gt; 0) {
                        cdnResources.push({
                            type: entry.initiatorType,
                            url: entry.name,
                            domain: window.location.hostname,
                            duration: entry.duration,
                            device: getDeviceType(),
                            transferSize: entry.transferSize || 0
                        });
                    }
                });
                return cdnResources;
            }

            function getDeviceType() {
                const ua = navigator.userAgent;

                // Check for Android devices first
                if (/android/i.test(ua)) {
                    // If &#34;mobile&#34; is not in the UA, it&#39;s likely a tablet
                    if (!/mobile/i.test(ua)) {
                    return &#39;tablet&#39;;
                    }
                    return &#39;mobile&#39;;
                }

                // Check for iOS devices
                if (/iPad|iPhone|iPod/.test(ua)) {
                    // iPadOS 13+ sometimes presents as desktop (MacIntel) but has touch support
                    if (/iPad/.test(ua)) {
                    return &#39;tablet&#39;;
                    }
                    return &#39;mobile&#39;;
                }

                // Check for iPad on iOS 13+ (it may report as MacIntel)
                if (navigator.platform === &#39;MacIntel&#39; &amp;&amp; navigator.maxTouchPoints &gt; 1) {
                    return &#39;tablet&#39;;
                }

                // Fallback: if none of the above, assume desktop
                return &#39;desktop&#39;;
            }

            function sendCdnUsageBeacon(e) {
                const resources = collectCdnResources();
                if (resources.length &gt; 0) {
                const data = JSON.stringify({
                    domain: window.location.hostname,
                    timestamp: Date.now(),
                    resources: resources
                });
                const endpoint = &#39;https://boost.berqwp.com/optimize/cdn/bandwidth/&#39;;

                // Attempt to send using sendBeacon first.
                const beaconSent = navigator.sendBeacon(endpoint, data);

                // Fallback to fetch with keepalive if sendBeacon fails.
                if (!beaconSent) {
                    fetch(endpoint, {
                        method: &#39;POST&#39;,
                        headers: { &#39;Content-Type&#39;: &#39;application/json&#39; },
                        body: data,
                        keepalive: true
                    }).catch(err =&gt; {
                        console.error(&#39;Fetch keepalive error:&#39;, err);
                    });
                }
                }

            }

            // Use pagehide event for most modern browsers.
            window.addEventListener(&#39;beforeunload&#39;, sendCdnUsageBeacon);

        })();
    </script>

    <script id="create-blob">
      // Get all script tags in the document
                var scriptTags = document.getElementsByTagName(&#39;script&#39;);

                // Loop through each script tag
                for (let i = 0; i &lt; scriptTags.length; i++) {
                    const scriptTag = scriptTags[i];

                    // Check if the script tag contains the data-berqwp-js attribute
                    const berqwpAttribute = scriptTag.getAttribute(&#39;data-berqwp-js&#39;);
                    if (berqwpAttribute) {
                        // Decode the base64 encoded string
                        const decodedString = atob(berqwpAttribute);

                        // Extract the inner content of the decoded string
                        const match = decodedString.match(/&lt;script[^&gt;]*&gt;([\s\S]+)&lt;\/script&gt;/i);
                        if (match &amp;&amp; match.length &gt; 1) {
                            const innerContent = match[1];

                            // Convert the inner content into a Blob
                            const blob = new Blob([innerContent], { type: &#39;application/javascript&#39; });

                            // Create a new script tag with the blob content
                            const newScriptTag = document.createElement(&#39;script&#39;);
                            newScriptTag.src = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
                            console.log(URL.createObjectURL(blob))

                            // Convert the newScriptTag HTML string to base64
                            const newScriptTagHtml = newScriptTag.outerHTML;
                            const base64Encoded = btoa(newScriptTagHtml);

                            // Add the base64 encoded string back to the data-berqwp-js attribute of the original script tag
                            scriptTag.setAttribute(&#39;data-berqwp-js&#39;, base64Encoded);
                        }
                    }
                }

      // Function to cache and load scripts
                            async function cache_file(url) {
                                const cache = await caches.open(&#39;berqwp-cache&#39;);

                                // Check if the resource is already cached
                                const cachedResponse = await cache.match(url);
                                if (cachedResponse) {
                                    console.log(&#39;Script is already cached:&#39;, url);
                                } else {
                                    // Fetch and cache the resource
                                    const response = await fetch(url, { cache: &#39;reload&#39; });
                                    if (response.ok) {
                                        await cache.put(url, response.clone());
                                        console.log(&#39;Fetched and cached script:&#39;, url);
                                    } else {
                                        console.error(&#39;Failed to fetch script:&#39;, response.statusText);
                                    }
                                }
                            }

    <script data-mode="5">
      function berqwpLoadJs() {

                    (function () {
                        &#39;use strict&#39;;
                        const VERSION = &#39;3.0&#39;;
                        let activated = false;
                        const pendingScripts = new Map();
                        let completedCount = 0;
                        let scriptQueue = [];
                        let currentlyLoading = null;

                        // Custom Event System
                        const createTrackerEvent = (name, detail = {}) =&gt;
                            new CustomEvent(`bwp:${name}`, {
                                detail: {
                                    version: VERSION,
                                    timestamp: performance.now(),
                                    ...detail
                                }
                            });

                        // Lifecycle listener capture:
                        // While a script is loading (_capturing=true), any addEventListener call
                        // for readystatechange/DOMContentLoaded/load is queued instead of registered
                        // natively. After all scripts finish, those listeners are replayed directly
                        // (listener.call(target, event)) so they fire exactly once in the right order.
                        const _captureEvents = [&#39;readystatechange&#39;, &#39;DOMContentLoaded&#39;, &#39;load&#39;];
                        const _captured = { readystatechange: [], DOMContentLoaded: [], load: [] };
                        let _capturing = false;
                        let _jqHeld = false;
                        const _origAddEventListener = EventTarget.prototype.addEventListener;
                        EventTarget.prototype.addEventListener = function(type, listener, options) {
                            if (_capturing &amp;&amp; _captureEvents.includes(type) &amp;&amp; typeof listener === &#39;function&#39;) {
                                _captured[type].push({ target: this, listener, options });
                                return;
                            }
                            _origAddEventListener.call(this, type, listener, options);
                        };

                        // Expose replay so the outer berqwp_after_delay_js_loaded handler can call it.
                        window._bwpReplayLifecycle = function() {
                            if (typeof jQuery !== &#39;undefined&#39; &amp;&amp; _jqHeld &amp;&amp; typeof jQuery.holdReady !== &#39;undefined&#39;) {
                                jQuery.holdReady(false);
                            }
                            _captureEvents.forEach(function(eventName) {
                                _captured[eventName].forEach(function(entry) {
                                    try {
                                        entry.listener.call(entry.target, new Event(eventName, { bubbles: true, cancelable: true }));
                                    } catch(e) {}
                                });
                                _captured[eventName].length = 0;
                            });

                            setTimeout(function() {
                                document.querySelectorAll(&#39;:not(script)[src]&#39;).forEach(function(el) {
                                    el.dispatchEvent(new Event(&#39;load&#39;, { bubbles: false }));
                                });
                            }, 0);
                        };

                        // Activation System
                        function activate() {
                            if (activated) return;
                            activated = true;
                            document.dispatchEvent(createTrackerEvent(&#39;activation&#39;));

                            // Remove listeners
                            [&#39;mousemove&#39;, &#39;click&#39;, &#39;scroll&#39;, &#39;keydown&#39;].forEach(evt =&gt; {
                                window.removeEventListener(evt, activate, true);
                            });

                            processScripts();
                            setupObserver();
                        }

                        function processScripts() {
                            const scripts = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(&#39;script[type=&#34;text/bwp-script&#34;]:not([data-earlyberqwp])&#39;));
                            scriptQueue = scripts.map(script =&gt; ({ script, processed: false }));
                            loadNextScript();
                        }

                        function loadNextScript() {
                            if (currentlyLoading) return;
                            const nextItem = scriptQueue.find(item =&gt; !item.processed);
                            if (!nextItem) return;
                            currentlyLoading = nextItem.script;
                            convertScript(nextItem.script);
                        }

                        function setupObserver() {
                            new MutationObserver(mutations =&gt; {
                                mutations.forEach(mutation =&gt; {
                                    mutation.addedNodes.forEach(node =&gt; {
                                        if (node.tagName === &#39;SCRIPT&#39; &amp;&amp; node.type === &#39;text/bwp-script&#39;) {
                                            scriptQueue.push({ script: node, processed: false });
                                            if (!currentlyLoading) loadNextScript();
                                        }
                                    });
                                });
                            }).observe(document, { childList: true, subtree: true });
                        }

                        // Script Conversion
                        function convertScript(original) {
                            if (original.dataset.processed) return;
                            original.dataset.processed = &#39;true&#39;;

                            const script = document.createElement(&#39;script&#39;);
                            const attrs = Array.from(original.attributes).filter(a =&gt; a.name !== &#39;type&#39;);
                            const id = `script-${performance.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)}`;

                            script.type = original.getAttribute(&#39;data-type&#39;);
                            try {
                                attrs.forEach(attr =&gt; script.setAttribute(attr.name, attr.value));
                            } catch (e) {
                            }
                            if (original.textContent) script.textContent = original.textContent;

                            pendingScripts.set(id, {
                                element: script,
                                src: script.src,
                                isExternal: !!script.src
                            });

                            document.dispatchEvent(createTrackerEvent(&#39;script-loading&#39;, {
                                scriptId: id,
                                element: script
                            }));

                            const onScriptComplete = (success) =&gt; {
                                _capturing = false;
                                if (!_jqHeld &amp;&amp; typeof jQuery !== &#39;undefined&#39; &amp;&amp; typeof jQuery.holdReady !== &#39;undefined&#39;) {
                                    jQuery.holdReady(true);
                                    _jqHeld = true;
                                }
                                const queueItem = scriptQueue.find(item =&gt; item.script === original);
                                if (queueItem) queueItem.processed = true;
                                handleCompletion(id, success);
                                currentlyLoading = null;
                                // if (typeof window._bwpReplayLifecycle === &#39;function&#39;) window._bwpReplayLifecycle();
                                setTimeout(loadNextScript, 0);
                            };

                            _origAddEventListener.call(script, &#39;load&#39;, () =&gt; onScriptComplete(true));
                            _origAddEventListener.call(script, &#39;error&#39;, () =&gt; onScriptComplete(false));

                            if (script.src) {
                                const observer = new MutationObserver(() =&gt; {
                                    if (!document.contains(script)) {
                                        observer.disconnect();
                                        console.log(&#39;Script not found. Skipping &#39;, script.src)
                                        onScriptComplete(true);
                                    }
                                });
                                observer.observe(document, { childList: true, subtree: true });
                                
                            }

                            _capturing = true;
                            original.replaceWith(script);

                            if (!script.src &amp;&amp; script.textContent) {
                                setTimeout(() =&gt; onScriptComplete(true), 0);
                            }

                            if (!script.textContent &amp;&amp; !script.src) {
                                setTimeout(() =&gt; onScriptComplete(true), 0);
                            }
                        }

                        function handleCompletion(id, success) {
                            const record = pendingScripts.get(id);
                            if (!record) return;

                            pendingScripts.delete(id);
                            completedCount++;

                            document.dispatchEvent(createTrackerEvent(&#39;script-complete&#39;, {
                                scriptId: id,
                                success,
                                duration: performance.now() - record.element.startTime
                            }));

                            const allQueued = scriptQueue.every(item =&gt; item.processed);
                            if (pendingScripts.size === 0 &amp;&amp; allQueued) {
                                document.dispatchEvent(createTrackerEvent(&#39;scripts-loaded&#39;, {
                                    total: completedCount,
                                    failed: 0
                                }));
                            }
                        }

                        document.addEventListener(&#39;bwp:scripts-loaded&#39;, (e) =&gt; {
                            console.log(&#39;all scripts loaded&#39;)
                            window.dispatchEvent(new Event(&#39;berqwp_after_delay_js_loaded&#39;));
                        });

                        // Initialization
                        activate();
                    })();
                }
    </script>
    <script>
      (function(){
                            // Select all inline script tags with type=&#34;text/bwp-script&#34;
                            const inlineScripts = document.querySelectorAll(&#39;script[type=&#34;text/bwp-script&#34;]&#39;);

                            inlineScripts.forEach((script) =&gt; {
                                // Get the content of the inline script
                                const scriptContent = script.innerHTML;

                                if (!scriptContent) {
                                    return;
                                }

                                if (script.getAttribute(&#39;data-type&#39;) == &#39;module&#39;) {
                                    return;
                                }

                                // Create a Blob from the script content
                                const blob = new Blob([scriptContent], { type: &#39;application/javascript&#39; });

                                // Create a URL for the Blob
                                const scriptURL = URL.createObjectURL(blob);

                                // Create a new external script tag
                                const newScript = document.createElement(&#39;script&#39;);
                                newScript.src = scriptURL;
                                newScript.type = &#39;text/bwp-script&#39;;  // Or &#39;text/bwp-script&#39;, but &#39;application/javascript&#39; is more typical for JS
                                newScript.setAttribute(&#39;data-type&#39;, script.getAttribute(&#39;data-type&#39;));

                                // Copy other attributes if necessary
                                Array.from(script.attributes).forEach(function(attr) {
                                    if (attr.name !== &#39;type&#39; &amp;&amp; attr.name !== &#39;src&#39;) {
                                        newScript.setAttribute(attr.name, attr.value);
                                    }
                                });

                                // Replace the original inline script with the new external script tag
                                script.parentNode.replaceChild(newScript, script);
                            });



                        })();

    <script id="optimize-js" async="">
      let js_execution_mode = &#39;5&#39;;
            let js_loading = &#39;delay&#39;;

            let berq_content = true;
            var berq_click = null;

            function preloadJS(jsURLs) {
                // jsURLs = jsURLs.filter((item) =&gt; item &amp;&amp; !item.includes(&#39;blob:&#39;));

            let bwp_css_initialized = false;

                    .then(() =&gt; {

                    });

            }

            let bwp_lastScrollY = window.scrollY;
            const bwp_SCROLL_THRESHOLD = 10;

            function berqwp_js_handleUserInteraction(event) {

                if (event.type === &#39;click&#39; || event.type === &#39;touchstart&#39;) {
                    berq_click = event.target;

                    // Traverse up the DOM to find the closest &lt;a&gt; ancestor
                    if (berq_click.closest(&#39;a&#39;)) {
                        berq_click = berq_click.closest(&#39;a&#39;);
                    }

                    // If click is done on a link
                    if (berq_click.tagName === &#39;A&#39; &amp;&amp; berq_click.href &amp;&amp; /^https?:\/\//.test(berq_click.href)) {
                        console.log(&#39;Skipping JavaScript execution, a link was clicked.&#39;)
                        return;
                    }

                    console.log(event.type)
                    // event.preventDefault();
                }

                if (event.type == &#39;scroll&#39;) {
                    const currentScrollY = window.scrollY;
                    const diff = Math.abs(currentScrollY - bwp_lastScrollY);

                    if (diff &lt; bwp_SCROLL_THRESHOLD) {
                        return;
                    }
                }

                bwp_js_init(jsUrls);
                bwp_css_init(cssUrls);


                // After running the function, remove all event listeners to ensure it runs only once
                for (let eventType of berqwp_js_interactionEventTypes) {
                    window.removeEventListener(eventType, berqwp_js_handleUserInteraction);
                }
            }

            let berqwp_js_interactionEventTypes = [&#39;click&#39;, &#39;mousemove&#39;, &#39;keydown&#39;, &#39;touchstart&#39;, &#39;scroll&#39;, &#39;berqwpLoadJS&#39;, &#39;berqwp_interaction_event&#39;];

                function whenScriptsAreIdle({
                  idleTime = 300,   // ms of quiet time
                  timeout = 10000  // max wait
                } = {}) {
                  return new Promise((resolve) =&gt; {
                    let pending = new Set();
                    let idleTimer;
                    let resolved = false;

                    function done() {
                      if (resolved) return;
                      resolved = true;
                      observer.disconnect();
                      resolve();
                    }

                    function resetIdleTimer() {
                      clearTimeout(idleTimer);
                      idleTimer = setTimeout(() =&gt; {
                        if (pending.size === 0) done();
                      }, idleTime);
                    }

                    function track(script) {
                      if (script.dataset._tracked) return;
                      script.dataset._tracked = &#39;1&#39;;

                      // Inline scripts execute immediately
                      if (!script.src) {
                        resetIdleTimer();
                        return;
                      }

                      pending.add(script);

                      const cleanup = () =&gt; {
                        pending.delete(script);
                        resetIdleTimer();
                      };

                      script.addEventListener(&#39;load&#39;, cleanup, { once: true });
                      script.addEventListener(&#39;error&#39;, cleanup, { once: true });
                    }

                    // Track existing scripts
                    document.querySelectorAll(&#39;script&#39;).forEach(track);

                    // Observe new scripts
                    const observer = new MutationObserver((mutations) =&gt; {
                      for (const m of mutations) {
                        for (const node of m.addedNodes) {
                          if (node.tagName === &#39;SCRIPT&#39;) {
                            track(node);
                          } else if (node.querySelectorAll) {
                            node.querySelectorAll(&#39;script&#39;).forEach(track);
                          }
                        }
                      }
                    });

                    observer.observe(document.documentElement, {
                      childList: true,
                      subtree: true
                    });

                    // Safety timeout
                    setTimeout(done, timeout);

                    resetIdleTimer();
                  });
                }

                if (berq_click) {
                    whenScriptsAreIdle({ idleTime: 800 }).then(() =&gt; {
                        setTimeout(function() {
                            console.log(berq_click);
                            const clickEvent = new MouseEvent(&#39;click&#39;, {
                                bubbles: true,
                                cancelable: false,
                                view: window
                            });
                            berq_click.dispatchEvent(clickEvent);
                            berq_click = null;
                        }, 500)
                    });
                }
            });
    </script>
